reuse.why: Fintegra reuses bank selection and linking, and all providers share link validation, but local unlink cleanup and transaction-download logic are copied.

duplication.why: The diff duplicates local unlink cleanup, the existing transaction-download pattern, and guard-then-link orchestration across six registrations.

placement.why: Changes follow existing account, sync, configuration and model layers, although provider-neutral linking is awkwardly housed in the SimpleFin handler.

scope.why: All edits support the requested linking rules, takeover option or Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Centralized rules help maintenance, but a validation-named helper now mutates accounts and a provider-specific request handler exposes internal reuse parameters.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing bank-selection and sync abstractions are used; unlinkAccount includes remote cleanup, so it cannot directly serve local-only takeover.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes existing download logic with compact arguments and renamed response variables while retaining token lookup, POST, error handling and response mapping.

abstraction_drift.where: linkSimpleFinAccount gains syncSource and bankId overrides; ensureAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and accumulates closed-target rejection and replacement branches, including mutation under a validation-oriented name.
